The background is a plain, light-colored wall with vertical blinds visible on the right.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring in the finest details of the mesh links where they overlap, potentially indicating minor generation smoothing or focus issues, though likely within acceptable photographic variance.
The way the necklace sits on the skin shows very little displacement or shadowing, making it look slightly 'pasted on' rather than physically heavy, but this is subtle.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry (mesh/chainmail vs standard chain) and verify class alignment.
To audit the complex topology of the mesh links and ensure no fusion artifacts between the metal rings or with the skin.
To assess overall photorealism, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle generative artifacts in the skin or fabric.
To verify the physical separation between the necklace and the skin/clothing, ensuring proper occlusion and depth ordering.

focus_areas: Integrity of individual mesh links (no fusion/melting)
Physical interaction between necklace and skin (shadows/displacement)
Consistency of metallic reflections across the curved surface
Boundary sharpness between necklace and background/skin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the mesh necklace. AI generators often struggle with repeating intricate patterns like chainmail, leading to fused links or inconsistent ring sizes. Verify if the 'weight' of the necklace is visually convincing through skin indentation or shadowing.
